purpose: A single box for an independent yes/no choice that takes effect when the form is submitted, or a parent row that sums up a partly checked list (indeterminate). It is the bare box: give it a visible label.

notFor.case: The setting applies the moment it changes, with no Save step.
A checkbox that needs its own visible label and description in one row.
Several related options under one question, with a group label and an error.
The person must pick exactly one option out of several.

Checked=false.visual: Empty box: Surface/input fill, Border/control edge (inverse: Surface/inverse fill, Border/inverse edge).

Checked=true.visual: Filled box with the check glyph: Action/primary/default fill and edge with a Content/on-action glyph (default); Content/primary with Content/inverse (secondary); Status/<severity>/surface-solid with Status/<severity>/on-solid (critical, success, info); Content/inverse with Content/primary (inverse).

Checked=indeterminate.meaning: A parent whose children are partly checked; the app derives it. Space moves it to checked.
Checked=indeterminate.visual: The same fills as Checked=true, with the indeterminate glyph instead of the check.

Default.visual: The fill and edge of its Checked value; no focus ring.

Hover.visual: Unchecked: the edge moves to Border/control-hover. Checked or indeterminate: the fill moves to its hover role (Action/primary/hover, Content/secondary for secondary, Status/<severity>/surface-solid-hover, Content/inverse-secondary for inverse).

Focused.visual: Focus edge and ring in the variant's roles: Border/focus + Border/ring/default (default), Border/strong + Border/subtle (secondary), Status/<severity>/border-strong + Status/<severity>/border (status variants), Border/inverse + Surface/inverse-muted (inverse).

Disabled.meaning: Cannot be changed and leaves the tab order.
Disabled.visual: Fill and edge Action/disabled/default, glyph Content/disabled, in every variant and Checked value.

Invalid.visual: The edge turns Status/critical/border-strong; the fill keeps its Checked value.

a11y.keyboard: Tab reaches the box (one tab stop) unless disabled. Space toggles it; indeterminate goes to checked (Radix Checkbox).
notes: Needs a label: CheckboxItem, or a Label with htmlFor. The box alone has no accessible name.
Invalid is shown by the edge colour only; the error text must come from CheckboxGroup's footer or a Field.
Fill and edge move on use-hover, the focus ring on use-focus (recipes/motion.ts).

openQuestions: Reduced motion: should the fill, edge and focus-ring transitions (use-hover, use-focus) be dropped, or kept because they carry no travel?
Size xs and sm draw the same box (16, Size/selector-sm); only CheckboxItem's text differs. Is a separate xs box intended?
